faqs.question: How do I know this keyboard fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the Lenovo IdeaPad G500, G505, G505A, G510, G700, G710, G700A and G500AM, which share the same chassis. If you're unsure of your exact model, send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Is it backlit?
faqs.answer: No, this model does not come with backlighting from the factory, so we only stock the non-backlit version.
